The front left headlight and bumper area look somewhat indistinct and 'melted' into the body panel. The geometry lacks the crisp mechanical definition expected of a manufactured vehicle part.
The curve of the rear fender over the back tire seems slightly asymmetrical compared to the front, though this could be partly due to the viewing angle.
